title: Flow Package Metadata
description: Metadata for a flow package directory. A flow package bundles a flow definition, role definitions, and package metadata into a self-contained unit.

schema_version.description: Schema contract version for the flow package metadata file.

id.description: Unique package identifier. Used for resolution and cross-referencing.

type.description: Package type. Must be 'flow' for flow packages.

description.description: Human-readable description of the package's purpose.
